About this space
Travelling to Bulawayo, experience the perfect blend of style and tranquility at The Mulberry Place self contained Guesthouse. Equipped with a double bed. Ideal for business travelers looking for a peaceful escape, those visiting the city for family gatherings as well as children's sports weekends. Enjoy the privacy and convenience of having your own private bathroom, and kitchenette. Relax and unwind in our beautiful and well-kept garden. Come experience the serenity for yourself.

Other things to note
The Mulberry Place is 9km to cbd.
Private taxis from town are available from as little as usd5 to usd10 depending on the taxi.
Public transport in kombis is also available from town at 50cents per trip and you can be dropped off at the gate.
